sources.snippet: We introduce the Yi model family, a series of language and multimodal models that demonstrate strong multi-dimensional capabilities. The Yi model family is based on 6B and 34B pretrained language models, then we extend them to chat models, 200K long context models, depth-upscaled models, and vision-language models. sources.title: PhonikudModel Architecture | thewh1teagle/phonikud | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Architecture Overview The PhonikudModel extends the base BertForDiacritization architecture from DictaBERT with additional prediction capabilities. It implements a multi-headed approach where the base model handles standard nikud and shin/sin prediction, while an additional MLP head predicts enhanced diacritical features.
